'''81 ABY''', or '''81<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> After the Battle of Yavin''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The document ''[[Portraits in Late Galactic History]]'' by [[Thull Kabanard]] was published in 81 ABY. It detailed the history of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], a conflict fought between factions including the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Confederation]]<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> from [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] to [[41 ABY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
81 ABY was introduced in the [[2012]] book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />
